editorNotes.purpose: Original grammar-error-identification bank for Level 1 Stage 1, meeting the approved 20-item allocation only; not the complete stage bank.
editorNotes.reviewNotes: Original Grade 3 grammar items covering subject-verb agreement, verb tense, plurals, pronouns and conditional forms. Requires editorial and pedagogical review before approval or publication.

questions.prompt: Read the sentence: “The birds sings near our window each morning.” Which part contains the grammar error?

source.reference: Newly authored English Aptitude grammar-error-identification item for Level 1, Stage 1.

rights.basis: Original prompt and options authored for this project.

feedback.correct: “Birds” is plural, so the verb should be “sing.”
feedback.incorrect: Check which part of the sentence does not follow the grammar rule, then consider the form that would make it correct.

questions.explanation: “Birds” is plural, so the verb should be “sing.”

questions.prompt: Read the sentence: “Mina have her blue bag today.” Which part contains the grammar error?

source.reference: Newly authored English Aptitude grammar-error-identification item for Level 1, Stage 1.

rights.basis: Original prompt and options authored for this project.

feedback.correct: With “Mina,” the present-tense verb should be “has.”
feedback.incorrect: Check which part of the sentence does not follow the grammar rule, then consider the form that would make it correct.

questions.explanation: With “Mina,” the present-tense verb should be “has.”

questions.prompt: Read the sentence: “We was ready before the bell rang.” Which part contains the grammar error?

source.reference: Newly authored English Aptitude grammar-error-identification item for Level 1, Stage 1.

rights.basis: Original prompt and options authored for this project.

feedback.correct: “We” takes “were,” so the phrase should be “were ready.”
feedback.incorrect: Check which part of the sentence does not follow the grammar rule, then consider the form that would make it correct.

questions.explanation: “We” takes “were,” so the phrase should be “were ready.”

questions.prompt: Read the sentence: “He putted the books on the shelf.” Which part contains the grammar error?

questions.prompt: Read the sentence: “Ravi did not ate his breakfast.” Which part contains the grammar error?

feedback.correct: After “did not,” use the base verb “eat,” not “ate.”

questions.explanation: After “did not,” use the base verb “eat,” not “ate.”

questions.prompt: Read the sentence: “She is taller than me am.” Which part contains the grammar error?
